title: CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE from AES SETKEY: correct design, defend against 'just return 0'
description: crypto2dev_aes_setkey_ctx() returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE instead of 0. A future contributor might assume 0 (handled) is more correct. It is not: returning 0 skips the software key schedule, leaving aes->rounds=0, which causes wc_AesGcmEncrypt to call wc_AesEncrypt for the H-subkey and fail with KEYUSAGE_E. The hardware cipher path checks devCtx first and uses the device regardless of what the software schedule produced. The CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE return is load-bearing. The comment at line 542-549 explains this correctly and should not be removed.
